spans.s:
योतु m. (-तुः)
 1. Measure in general.
 2. Cleaning, purifying.
 3. A clean-
ser, a purifier.
 E. यु to mix, or not to mix, and तुन् Unādi aff.

योत्र n. (-त्रं) The tie that fastens the yoke of a plough to the neck of
the ox.
 E. यु to join, ष्ट्रन् aff.

योत्स्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) About to fight, ready to fight.
 E. युध् to fight,
desid. v., future tense, शतृ aff.
